submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 10 (Co0.64Sb0.36) had the highest EQE, 0.00886%. It was about 10x higher than index 4 (Co0.81Sb0.19, 0.00083%) and 17x higher than index 19 (Co0.34Sb0.66, 0.00052%). So EQE peaks at intermediate Sb, somewhere between the two ends. XRD at indices 3, 10, 19 and 26 shows the same rutile-type phase across the whole line. A second phase, likely Sb-rich, appears from index 19 upward. Index 10 is effectively single-phase.
